title: Live Commerce / 01 · Tổng quan dịch vụ
description: Golden signals, đơn hàng, livestream – màn hình NOC.

options.content: **Live Commerce – NOC.** Traffic/lỗi/đơn hàng lấy từ **log Kong qua Loki** (app chưa có `/metrics`, Prometheus CMC không scrape Kong). Hạ tầng lấy từ Prometheus CMC (`cmc-monitoring`, retention **1 ngày**). Latency p95 chỉ có sau khi bật log format `lc_combined` cho Kong.

panels.title: Deployment sẵn sàng
panels.description: Tổng replica available / desired của mọi Deployment trong namespace đã chọn.

targets.expr: sum(kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{namespace=~"$namespace"}) / sum(kube_deployment_spec_replicas{namespace=~"$namespace"})

panels.title: Request/s (Kong)
panels.description: Tổng request qua Kong (không tính health-check của ingress-controller).

targets.expr: sum(rate({namespace="kong", container="proxy"} != "kong-ingress-controller" | regexp `^\S+ \S+ \S+ \[[^\]]+\] "(?P<method>[A-Z]+) (?P<path>[^ ?"]*)[^"]*" (?P<status>\d{3}) ` | status != "" | label_format svc=`{{ if hasPrefix "/api/products" .path }}product-service{{ else if hasPrefix "/api/auth" .path }}auth-service{{ else if hasPrefix "/api/orders" .path }}order-service{{ else if hasPrefix "/api/sellers" .path }}live-manager{{ else if hasPrefix "/api/sessions" .path }}live-manager{{ else if hasPrefix "/api/lives" .path }}live-manager{{ else if hasPrefix "/ws" .path }}chat-service{{ else if hasPrefix "/socket.io" .path }}chat-service{{ else }}web{{ end }}` | label_format path=`{{ regexReplaceAll "/[0-9]+" (regexReplaceAll "[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}" .path ":id") "/:id" }}` [5m]))

panels.title: Latency p95 / p99 theo service (cần log format lc_combined)
panels.description: Thời gian Kong xử lý request ($request_time). Trống nếu Kong vẫn dùng log format mặc định.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {namespace="kong", container="proxy"} != "kong-ingress-controller" | regexp `^\S+ \S+ \S+ \[[^\]]+\] "(?P<method>[A-Z]+) (?P<path>[^ ?"]*)[^"]*" (?P<status>\d{3}) ` | status != "" | label_format svc=`{{ if hasPrefix "/api/products" .path }}product-service{{ else if hasPrefix "/api/auth" .path }}auth-service{{ else if hasPrefix "/api/orders" .path }}order-service{{ else if hasPrefix "/api/sellers" .path }}live-manager{{ else if hasPrefix "/api/sessions" .path }}live-manager{{ else if hasPrefix "/api/lives" .path }}live-manager{{ else if hasPrefix "/ws" .path }}chat-service{{ else if hasPrefix "/socket.io" .path }}chat-service{{ else }}web{{ end }}` | label_format path=`{{ regexReplaceAll "/[0-9]+" (regexReplaceAll "[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}" .path ":id") "/:id" }}` | regexp `rt=(?P<rt>[0-9.]+)` | unwrap rt | svc=~"$service" [$__auto]) by (svc)
